name: Pennsylvania
short: Pennsylvania has no statewide home rebate in 2026, so your utility matters. PECO pays $200 to $300 for a heat pump, $350 for a heat pump water heater and $500 for rooftop solar. PPL Electric pays $225 to $500 for a heat pump and $400 for a heat pump water heater. Duquesne Light's rebate store says energy rebates are not available yet, and we could not confirm Penelec's amounts. The state Sunshine solar rebate closed in 2013 and the federal solar credit ended after 2025.
